name: skgate
description: MCP proxy with OAuth. Paste a GitHub repo URL (or a remote MCP server URL) and skgate builds it, runs it and serves it as an MCP endpoint behind OAuth, so Grok, Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients can connect with a normal sign-in. Idle servers are stopped to save RAM. It also gives you virtual API keys, it can turn a REST API with an OpenAPI description into MCP tools, and it proxies your SI providers behind one OpenAI-compatible address with model aliases. Your Grok subscription becomes that API too, with no API key. skgate is not an Unraid plugin and does not manage Unraid. It needs an OIDC provider for admin sign-in (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Zitadel and similar). Create a confidential client with the redirect URI PUBLIC_URL/admin/oidc/callback. Put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS: MCP clients need a public https address.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Database (skgate.db), encryption key (secrets.key) and managed upstream data. Back this up.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port of the web UI and the MCP, OAuth and /v1 endpoints.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The public https address clients use to reach skgate, no trailing slash. Example: https://skgate.example.com

variables.name: OIDC Issuer
variables.description: Issuer URL of your OIDC provider, for admin sign-in. Example: https://auth.example.com

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: Client ID of the confidential client you created for skgate. Redirect URI: PUBLIC_URL/admin/oidc/callback

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret for the OIDC client above.

variables.name: Allowed emails (optional)
variables.description: Comma list. Only these OIDC users may sign in as admin. Empty: every user your OIDC provider admits is an admin.

variables.name: Allowed groups (optional)
variables.description: Comma list of OIDC groups allowed to sign in as admin. Empty: no group restriction.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: For log timestamps and dates, for example America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID skgate runs as (Unraid: nobody = 99).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID skgate runs as (Unraid: users = 100).
